rows.label: tlk45450161_02_msg0001
rows.name:
I've seen you in Rijite Port before,
haven't I? You seem stronger than you
were before, though.

rows.label: tlk45450161_01_msg0002
rows.name:
When you leave this port and head for
Baldotas Island, the path splits in
two.

rows.label: tlk45450161_02_msg0003
rows.name:
The left-hand path is the safest
route to Iyasaki Village...

rows.label: tlk45450161_02_msg0004
rows.name:
If you want to test yourself,
you could try the right path.
Just don't blame me later.
